CARD_STRUCTURE.container: Rendered result list is under a React Native Web section with id=list-results-section-0.

FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.airline: Infer from source context/page; visible carrier name is site-level SpiceJet, not repeated per card.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.flight_number: Visible text token matching SG\s?\d{2,4}; observed SG 802.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.origin_airport: Visible IATA code after departure time in each row; observed DEL.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.destination_airport: Visible IATA code after arrival time in each row; observed BOM.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.departure_time: Visible HH:MM token before origin; observed 22:30.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.arrival_time: Visible HH:MM token before destination, with optional +1 suffix; observed 00:50+1.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.arrival_next_day_indicator: Visible +1 attached to arrival time and legend says Flight arrives next day.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.departure_date: Visible search summary/header: Depart Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 and result header Sat, 05 Sep 2026.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.total_fare: Visible fare amount in fare-family column; observed SpiceSaver INR 18,047 for SG 802.
FIELD_EXTRACTION_MAP.cabin_or_fare_family: Fare family columns visible: SpiceSaver, SpiceFlex, SpiceMax. Economy comes from search context, not a repeated card label.

moderate: Visible text row parsing around SG flight-number tokens
weak: global #total-price top summary for card-level association
SELECTOR_RELIABILITY.notes: The radio data-testid suffixes appear index-like; confirm on a page with multiple cards before depending on numeric suffix semantics.

FARE_INTERPRETATION.visible_statement: All the fare include taxes and fee. Top summary also says inclusive of taxes.
FARE_INTERPRETATION.interpretation: Displayed amounts are total fares inclusive of taxes/fees, not base fare.

SOLD_OUT_HANDLING.evidence: No sold out/unavailable text in saved result page.
SOLD_OUT_HANDLING.likely_parser_rule: Skip cards/fare-family cells whose visible text indicates sold out/unavailable/no flights or whose fare radio is absent/disabled; needs evidence before finalizing.

MULTIPLE_CARD_HANDLING.evidence: Only SG 802 was visible for the controlled DEL-BOM 2026-09-05 result.
MULTIPLE_CARD_HANDLING.assessment: Independent card boundaries appear feasible via repeated SG flight-number rows under #list-results-section-0, but require one more natural multi-card artifact for high confidence.

RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.source_id: Covered by caller/source lookup, not page DOM.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.route_id: Covered by caller/route lookup, not page DOM.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.departure_datetime: Covered from visible departure date + visible departure time.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.arrival_datetime: Covered from visible departure date + arrival time + visible +1 next-day marker.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.advance_window_days: Covered by collection date and visible departure date.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.base_fare: Not visible separately; do not invent. Keep unavailable/0 under current contract unless a legitimate visible breakdown is opened later.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.taxes_fees: Not visible separately; do not invent. Keep unavailable/0 under current contract unless a legitimate visible breakdown is opened later.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.total_fare: Covered: INR 18,047 visible and associated with SG 802 / SpiceSaver.
RAWQUOTE_FIELD_COVERAGE.cabin_class: Partially covered: Economy is search context; visible fare family can optionally enrich as ECONOMY-SPICESAVER if contract allows.

RISKS: Only one visible flight card in this artifact; multiple-card row boundaries need a follow-up fixture or supervised observation before high-confidence production rollout.
Generated css-* and r-* classes are brittle and should not be used.
Base fare and taxes/fees are not separately visible on the default result card.
The page also includes low-fare calendar prices and top summary prices; parser must avoid treating those as independent quotes.
RECOMMENDED_IMPLEMENTATION: Parse rendered DOM/text only after the normal public Playwright flow reaches /search.
Anchor card extraction under #list-results-section-0, ignoring lowfare carousel and top #total-price summary for quote creation.
Split rows by visible SG flight-number tokens; require exact DEL->BOM IATA sequence and visible date match.
Parse departure date from the result page summary/header and require it to match requested date.
Use visible lowest/default fare-family total as total_fare; keep base_fare/taxes_fees unavailable/0 unless visible breakdown is legitimately added later.
Add fixture tests using this after_click text/HTML before enabling production ingestion.
